title: test_sign uses -noverify: openssl does not validate the cert chain
description: smime_tests.rs test C, line 277: openssl smime -verify -noverify skips certificate chain validation. The test confirms the signature math is correct but does not confirm that openssl would accept the cert chain as trusted. This means a cert encoding bug in sign() output would not be caught. Fix: either remove -noverify and use -CAfile with proper self-signed test certs, or add an explicit comment explaining what the test does and does not cover.
